  requires true

=
  var i: int = 0
  var s: int = 0
  while i < 4
    invariant 0 <= i and i <= 4
    decreases 4 - i

  return s

  b[0] = 1

  b[2] = 1
  b[3] = 1

nodes.statement: Every tree with n >= 2 has at least two leaves.
nodes.plain_summary: Lemma `GT-LM-BC-TR-022` (graph in combinatorics): Every tree with n >= 2 has at least two leaves. This claim is discharged in Lean or via a closed specimen. Gap kind `axiom_layer` — see provability backlog. Proof technique tag: `axiom_layer`.

lean_snippet.content:
theorem gt_lm_bc_tr_022 (G : SimpleGraph V) [Fintype V] [DecidableRel G.Adj] [Nontrivial V]
    (ht : G.IsTree) : 2 ≤ #{v | G.degree v = 1} := by
  classical
  let leaves := Finset.univ.filter fun v => G.degree v = 1
  have hdeg_lb : ∀ v ∈ leavesᶜ, 2 ≤ G.degree v := by
    intro v hv
    simp only [leaves, Finset.mem_filter, Finset.mem_univ, true_and, Finset.mem_compl] at hv
    have hne : G.degree v ≠ 1 := by
      intro hdeg
      exact hv fun h => by simpa [leaves, hdeg] using h
    have hpos : 0 < G.degree v :=
      G.degree_pos_iff_exists_adj.mpr (ht.connected.exists_adj v)
    omega
  have hsum_lb : 2 * Fintype.card V - leaves.card ≤ ∑ v, G.degree v := by
    calc ∑ v, G.degree v
        = ∑ v ∈ leaves, G.degree v + ∑ v ∈ leavesᶜ, G.degree v := by
          rw [← Finset.sum_union, Finset.union_compl, Finset.sum_univ]
          exact Finset.disjoint_compl_left
      _ ≥ leaves.card + 2 * (Fintype.card V - leaves.card) := by
          gcongr
          · exact fun v hv => (Finset.mem_filter.mp hv).2
          · exact fun v hv => hdeg_lb v hv

nodes.statement: L-smoothness: ||grad f(x) - grad f(y)|| <= L ||x - y||.
nodes.plain_summary: Axiom `ML-AX-L-SMOOTH` (ml in optimization): L-smoothness: ||grad f(x) - grad f(y)|| <= L ||x - y||. Taken as an explicit axiom in the proof layer (not derived). Gap kind `axiom_layer` — see provability backlog. Proof technique tag: `axiom_layer`.

lean_snippet.content:
axiom l_smooth_axiom
  (L : ℝ) (n : Nat) (f : (Fin n → ℝ) → ℝ) (grad : (Fin n → ℝ) → (Fin n → ℝ)) :
  0 < L →
  ∀ x y : Fin n → ℝ, ‖grad x - grad y‖ ≤ L * ‖x - y‖

  b[2] = 0
  b[3] = 0

  {n : Nat} (hn : 0 < n) (μ : ℝ) (Ω : FiniteProbSpace n) (draws : Fin n → ℝ) :
  expect Ω draws = μ → expect Ω (fun _ => sampleMean hn draws) = μ

/-- Event probability on a finite outcome space. -/
noncomputable def eventProb {n : Nat} (Ω : FiniteProbSpace n) (S : Finset (Fin n)) : ℝ :=
  ∑ i in S, Ω.p i

/-- Variance via second moment: Var(X) = E[X²] − E[X]² (ST-LM-BC-VR-003). -/
noncomputable def variance {n : Nat} (Ω : FiniteProbSpace n) (X : Fin n → ℝ) : ℝ :=
  expect Ω (fun i => X i ^ 2) - (expect Ω X) ^ 2

nodes.formal_latex: Sample mean is an unbiased estimator of population mean (finite variance target).
